note: Approximate traces of the classic faunal boundaries, drawn from coastlines and shelf edges following standard published maps (e.g. Encyclopaedia Britannica). Schematic, not survey lines.

properties.name: Wallace's Line
properties.author: A. R. Wallace
properties.what: Divides Asian fauna (west) from Wallacean fauna (east) through the deep Lombok and Makassar straits, which never dried out at low sea level.

properties.name: Huxley's Line
properties.author: T. H. Huxley
properties.what: Huxley's modification of Wallace's Line: follows it in the south but runs west of the Philippines, placing Palawan with Borneo.

properties.name: Weber's Line
properties.author: M. Weber
properties.what: Line of faunal balance, where Asian and Australian animals are roughly equal in number, through the Molucca and Banda seas.

properties.name: Lydekker's Line
properties.author: R. Lydekker
properties.what: Western limit of Australian and New Guinean mainland fauna, following the edge of the Sahul shelf.
